theorems.name: cleaner_norm_power_recovers_integer_scalar_degree
theorems.assumptions: natural m,n; quadratic norm of integer m represented by m^2

provenance.manuscript: Relative Secant Cycles and Hodge Classes
provenance.claimed_statement: degree of the CM scalar is N_K/Q(tau)
provenance.standard_input: Stacks Project Lemma 39.9.8: degree of multiplication by m on dimension g is m^(2g)

verdict: The manuscript degree assertion fails already for the integral scalar 2 on an abelian fourfold: claimed degree 4, standard degree 256. This does not by itself disprove the desired Norm^n cohomological eigencharacter, which may require a different proof using the polarization action.
remaining_gap: prove the actual CM pullback and cohomological eigencharacter without confusing line-bundle scaling with isogeny degree
